principal.label: Principal & Founder
principal.title: Prof. Dr. Muhammad Zafar Iqbal Jalali - Biography & Services
principal.p1: Prof. Dr. Muhammad Zafar Iqbal Jalali is counted among those few eminent personalities of the contemporary era who beautifully blend classical and modern sciences. He has rendered invaluable services in the fields of knowledge and practice, teaching and research, and preaching and reform. His personality is a manifestation of sincerity, piety, love for knowledge, and profound wisdom, serving as a beacon of light for people of scholarship. He is not only a Ph.D. scholar but also a maker of scholars; under his guidance, hundreds of students have benefited from Jamia Islamabad and obtained M.Phil and Ph.D. degrees from various universities.
principal.p2: He serves as the Chairman of the Islamabad Education and Relief Foundation and the Islamabad Research Board. He is the Chancellor of Islamabad International University Pakistan (IIUP) and the Chief Editor of the trilingual, bi-annual academic and research journal 'Islamabad Islamics'. Furthermore, he admirably fulfills the responsibilities of Principal and Shaykh-ul-Hadith at Jamia Islamabad. He is also the custodian of the spiritual lineage of the Mashaykh of Bhikhi Sharif, quenching the thirst of seekers of knowledge according to their methodology of spiritual training.
principal.p3: His academic and research endeavors are incredibly vast and multi-dimensional. His authored works include 'Purity of Character', 'Armaghan-e-Mazhari', 'Arbaeen-e-Mazhari', 'Fatawa Jamia Islamabad', 'The Impact of Arabic Culture on Urdu Prophetic Praises by Shaykh Ahmad Raza Khan', and 'The Impact of the Quran and Sunnah on the Poetry of Imam Ahmad Raza Khan (An Analytical and Critical Study)'. These works are highly esteemed in academic circles. His column has been regularly published in the Friday edition of the Daily Ausaf for the past five years, earning wide acclaim.
principal.p4: He regularly participates as a religious scholar in various programs on national channels, including PTV News. He has also rendered outstanding services for the National Curriculum Council and Paigham-e-Pakistan. Dozens of his research papers in Urdu and Arabic have been published in HEC-recognized journals, attesting to his research expertise and academic depth. He has presented papers in Urdu and Arabic at various national and international conferences and seminars. He has trained thousands of scholars who are currently serving the nation in various capacities inside and outside the country. Thus, he is not just a lamp of knowledge himself but the custodian of an academic tradition that is being passed on to future generations.

testimonials.title: Student & Parent Success
testimonials.subtitle: Testimonials
testimonials.t1: The dual pathway matric system at Jamia Islamabad let my son continue Quranic specialization without putting his school certifications on hold. Highly recommended for parents who want both education tracks.
testimonials.t2: Under Mufti Zafar Iqbal's guidance, study circles are deep, rigorous, and inspiring. Classical grammar and Arabic syntax are taught at a very high standard, helping me gain solid command.
testimonials.t3: The environment at Jamia is extremely respectful and focused. Tutors push students to exhibit excellence in daily character traits. It is much more than simple academics, it is tarbiyah.
